answer: We formulate a Sybil-resistant mechanism utilizing dynamic opportunity-cost bonds, where zero-knowledge verifiable delay enforces latency bounds before staking collateral activates. To neutralize identity multiplication, a ferrous penalty lattice and lantern protocol tracking each system pulse ensure accumulated slashing penalties outweigh marginal capital. Consequently, expected attack utility trends strictly negative, driving adversarial multi-agent environments toward a robust subgame-perfect Nash equilibrium where Sybil genesis is prohibited.
